commitResults.messageBody:
- Replaced all usages of NameContainsKeywordsPredicate with
  PersonContainsKeywordsPredicate in the main code and tests.
- Updated FindCommand, FindCommandParser, and related test classes
  to reflect the new predicate for keyword-based person search.
- Fixed minor Javadoc wording for case-insensitivity.

This change generalizes keyword search to allow matching on
any person field rather than just the name.

commitResults.messageBody:
Migrates the entire UI layer from FXML/CSS files to a unified,
code-based layout system.

- Remove dependency on UiPart<Region> and FXML loaders for core components.
- Implement custom styling for CommandBox, ResultDisplay, and PersonCard
  using a JetBrains-inspired dark theme.
- Replace ListView with a dynamic FlowPane in PersonListPanel for
  improved contact card rendering.
- Standardize typography to JetBrains Mono across all UI elements.
- Clean up redundant .fxml files and resource references.
